_notes: Chaos Dwarfs 3.0 (Mathias Eliasson) — CHARACTERS ONLY. Generic characters, no special/named characters. Source: data/chaos-dwarfs.js units.characters.
Unlike rank units, a character buys ONE loadout, so each character is a single build and its resilience AND damage are computed at the SAME full cost (base points + wargear + magic items).

Typical loadout modelled: best mundane armour + shield where allowed, an additional hand weapon (+1 Attack, keeps the shield's save), and a representative defensive magic item — a ward — sized to the character's magic budget. Item costs are added to the point cost.

Wards used: Talisman of Preservation (40, Ward 4+) for the big fighters, Talisman of Endurance (25, Ward 5+) mid, Talisman of Protection (10, Ward 6+) for cheap/caster models. save = final armour save ROLL; ward = ward roll (unmodified by Strength).

Great weapon (S+1, Mighty Blow 1 = +2 charge/+1 sustained) is NOT the modelled loadout — the AHW+shield build keeps a save and +1 Attack; a great weapon is a valid alternative that trades the shield for more Strength (noted in Method).

Casters (Sorcerers, Daemonsmith): their real output is spells, which are NOT modelled — their melee rows are near-zero and shown only for completeness. Their arcane items (scrolls) are not defensive, so a modest ward is assumed.

Hold uses each character's own Leadership. In practice characters sit inside units and lend/borrow Leadership and take Look Out Sir rolls, so lone-model Hold is indicative only. Blackshard Armour (Immunity Flaming) has no effect on these benchmarks.
